summary: In March 2026 the ShinyHunters extortion gang breached at least one of the European Commission's Amazon Web Services accounts hosting the Europa.eu web platform and claimed to have stolen over 350 GB of data, including mail server dumps, databases, confidential documents and contracts, before access was blocked. The Commission confirmed a data breach; ShinyHunters listed the Commission on its leak site and released an archive of over 90 GB of allegedly stolen files.
